conclusions.reservation_model: C6-42 simulation reservation overestimates MEASURED child peak RSS by >11x at 1024^2/153 patches (9.17 GiB priced vs 0.72-0.77 GiB measured, all shapes). The model prices a full-plane envelope the streaming block engine never materializes. A recalibration candidate (Stage B) must be shape-aware (pixel-proportional coefficient + explicit safety margin), preserve reject semantics and ResourceAdmissionError exactly, and is review-gated as an amendment to the accepted C6-42 decision.
conclusions.thread_scaling: 8->6->4 threads costs only +5%/+14% engine; thread count is nearly flat. Shape choice should maximize wave count (workers), not threads.
conclusions.shape_lever: divisor shapes eliminate imbalance: 8x3 (3 waves) and 12x2 (2 waves) project below 6x4's 1370 s if contention stretch stays bounded; a cheap follow-up wave probe (8x3, 12x2 + engine_1x3, engine_1x2) selects the Stage-B target with measured data.
